name: cell-forging-declined-weapon-summons-a-powercell
notes: Cell Forging: 'choose one -- two durability counters on target weapon / summon a Powercell'. Not choosing a weapon (PASS) is the Powercell mode. It used to do nothing: the decline skipped the generated continuation that summons the token.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Cell Forging's optional-choice continuation (pufooz13xf:0:CardActivated-1) is a generated handler whose own decline branch is part of the card text, but Core's ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped it on PASS (queued without dontSkipOnPass): the Powercell was never summoned when no weapon was chosen. Fix: Grand Archive registers the handler as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass, asked by Core before it skips).
